title: [Bug]: token_count_utils.py does not list new OpenAI models
body:
### Describe the bug

Recent models are missing from the token_count_utils.py listing. Missing models include:

gpt-4-1106-preview
gpt-4-vision-preview
and 
gpt-3.5-turbo-1106






### Steps to reproduce

Call `get_max_token_limit`, `token_left` or `percentile_used` with any of these models. It will throw an exception.

### Expected Behavior

It should report the correct values and not throw an exception.
